name: What specific renovations or improvements are recommended before relisting a luxury home?

mainEntity.name: What specific renovations or improvements are recommended before relisting a luxury home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before relisting a luxury home, strategic renovations or improvements focus on maximizing buyer appeal and return on investment. This often includes cosmetic updates like fresh paint, updated lighting fixtures, or modernizing kitchen and bathroom finishes. Addressing any deferred maintenance or enhancing curb appeal can also make a significant difference. For properties in South Florida, ensuring outdoor living spaces are immaculate and highlighting features like smart home technology can be particularly impactful. Kelby Contreras can offer guidance on cost-effective improvements that resonate with high-end buyers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before relisting, focus on cosmetic updates, addressing deferred maintenance, and enhancing curb appeal to maximize buyer appeal and ROI.
